messages:
jenna_cs: quick check-in re: VegaHealth dedicated bring-up. need final quota confirmation + autoscale policy for go-live.

mike_sre: pulling shadow traffic now. will post recommended steady/burst in 30m.

diego_eng: FYI their steady sits ~1.6k qps; intermittent morning batch peaks to ~2.5k. recommend 2.8k steady, 3.8k burst with fallback to quantized model.

jenna_cs: thanks. can autoscale cover burst to 3.8k without cold-start spikes? we want graceful degradation not 500s.

mike_sre: propose scale-up trigger = 60% GPU util, scale-down = 30%, cooldown = 45s. enable soft-throttle at 82% to shed non-critical requests.

ellie_support: I'll draft a one-page oncall runbook: what to watch (GPU util, 5xx rate, latency p95), and who to page.

sam_pm: SLA check: 99.9% uptime, critical routes <300ms. fallback to smaller model permitted for best-effort endpoints only. include rollback steps in runbook.

ops_bot: KMS key attach pending (ticket KMS-4712). cannot run full load until attached.

jenna_cs: timeline: quota request today, autoscale + scripts by tomorrow, load test Thu 08:00 PT. mike run a staging smoke today at 17:00 PT and paste results.

mike_sre: will do. staging smoke at 17:00 PT.

diego_eng: will upload sanitized priming script to the runbook (no PII).

ellie_support: scheduling 30m enablement with Vega SREs Fri 10:00 PT.

jenna_cs: blockers?

mike_sre: only blocker is KMS attach. once that's live we can proceed.

jenna_cs: thanks team. I'll submit quota request and follow up on KMS ticket. reconvene after smoke. :thumbsup:
